{"notes": "VISIT 3 (7:00): Picture shows the full fish, all dark and connected to START. Both strokes run from the nose and cross at the tail neck. The extra dominoes at the lower join (~x18-19, y13-14) are still connected and harmless. Only Maya spoke this visit, and no hand labels were visible, so I still can't say who built what. I'm crediting outcomes, not individuals.

Maya: At 6:15 she told everyone 'all good, hands off, let it run.' That matches the picture, so the call was accurate and well timed, and it protected the finished work. It fits her earlier clear replan at 1:15 (nose start, crossing strokes, roles assigned). Leadership evidence is solid. I haven't seen her do hands-on work or confirm the replan reached Priya. Ask her about both and what she'd do differently.

Tom: Not seen this visit. Earlier: reported status at 5:00, thanked Leo, stayed off the join. Good discipline and collaboration. Still unknown whether he cleared the old tail.

Priya: Not seen since visit 1, when her pad showed the old start. Ask whether it was fixed and what she contributed.

Leo: Not seen this visit. Earlier: accurate check of the lower join and crossing, honest about the flaw, and he called a hands-off rule at the crossing. Still unclear what he physically built.

Review: ask all four privately who built what, who cleared the old tail, and what the replan cost. Don't rate on the final picture alone, since it can't separate individual contributions."}
